title: Fed’s divided rate decision threatens Bitcoin’s comeback as December hike looms
summary: The Federal Reserve held its target range at 3.75% to 4% on Oct. 28 on a 10-2 vote. Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack dissented, favoring an immediate quarter-point hike.
